findings.concentration_findings: Top20 are 20 unique symbols and split 9/11 across exit years, but 9/20 entered in September 2024.

entry_feature_findings.B60: Top20 breakout margins are not larger than the remainder.
entry_feature_findings.FULL40: Box width is modestly tighter; MA dispersion and direction efficiency are nearly level; vol ratio is slightly higher.
entry_feature_findings.MINVOL: Location is modestly lower; minimum-volume ratio is nearly indistinguishable despite being a frozen hard filter.
entry_feature_findings.RS: Top20 final-RS separation is modest overall; GROUP_A is stronger but GROUP_B is level with GROUP_C.

findings.exit_findings: MARKET_MA20_X2 contains 18/20 Top20 trades and the realized right tail; generic SET_CHANGE reason cannot be decomposed further from the frozen ledger.
findings.holding_period_findings: Top20 median hold/MFE/MAE are 33.5 sessions, +71.8763%, and -1.1144%, versus 10, +6.3433%, and -5.8419%.

top20_distinguishing_features.finding: Post-entry persistence and favorable excursion separate Top20 much more than measured entry features; no causality claimed.

methods.holding_excursions: first-entry-open gross underlying total-return path; corporate-action adjusted; exit day open only; realized return remains frozen engine cycle return
